title: Aviva Launches £50M Tokenized Sterling Fund Share Class on XRPL
why_it_matters: The launch extends a major European asset manager's tokenized money market offering from dollars into sterling while preserving the existing regulated fund structure.
caption:
RWA WIRE // INSTITUTIONS

Aviva Launches £50M Tokenized Sterling Fund Share Class on XRPL

Aviva Investors launched a tokenized share class of its £22 billion Sterling Liquidity Fund on the XRP Ledger and invested £50 million in the new class.
